[FACT] User is experiencing issues with fake followers on Instagram.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for ways to deal with fake followers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on growing their Instagram presence.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided 10 tips to deal with fake followers, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Report suspicious accounts to Instagram.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Use Instagram's built-in features to identify and remove fake followers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Block fake followers to prevent them from following in the first place.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use third-party apps like Followerwonk, Fake Follower Check, or Social Blade to identify fake followers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Analyze follower growth to identify unusual patterns.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Verify the account to deter fake followers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Avoid engaging with fake followers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Focus on engagement metrics rather than follower count.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Monitor content to avoid attracting fake followers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Regularly clean up the follower list.  
[USER] User expressed gratitude for the tips and mentioned they would try them out.
